enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Echoes of Angdrelve 4: Eager to taste the flesh of your enemies, this wicked sword drips burning acid at your command. Each strike from this devastating weapon deals an additional 4d6 Acid damage on each hit.
Wounding 2: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 2 Constitution damage on each hit.
Anarchic 4: On Hit: 4 to 16 Chaos damage. Chaos-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Lawful user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.

Slay Living: This weapon stores a dark and sinister power deep within. When the weapon is used, this power occasionally comes to the surface, attempting to instantly snuff out the life force of the enemy.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
